audience: Internal capability proof for Pixel Plus: shows owners and clients that the studio can edit real footage of real people and animate around them
promise: Real footage + motion design in one deterministic pipeline: cutouts, tracking, reframing, karaoke captions, ducked mix
cta: None (internal study; the owner decides whether to show it)
direction: One real person (CC BY 4.0 sample footage) carried through five live-action techniques: text behind subject, freeze-frame character intro with sticker outline, pixel halo orbiting through the matte sandwich, punch-in jump cut, head breaking out of a card. Brand blue world, Alexandria + Space Mono, scratch Arabic voiceover with word-timed captions, ducked 120 BPM bed.

creative.viewer: a business owner deciding whether this studio can handle their talking-head or product-with-people ad
creative.problem: motion-only reels do not prove live-action skills; real footage needs mattes, tracking and an edit
creative.promise: real people, cut, captioned and animated around
creative.evidence: a real, licensed person-video and the measured analysis pack
creative.emotion: surprise at graphics that live inside the shot
creative.motif: brand-blue pixels that pass behind and in front of a real person
creative.light: the footage's own flat office light; the brand world is saturated blue
creative.camera: auto-reframed crop that follows the subject, punch-ins, freeze push
creative.motion: matte sandwich, tracked anchors, sticker outline, karaoke captions
creative.sound: 120 BPM soft bed ducked under the voice, whoosh/riser/pop on edit events
creative.pacing: a new technique every 1.8–3.4 s, readable caption pages
creative.payoff: his head breaks out of the card above the title

shots.purpose: hook: he walks toward camera through the giant word «حقيقي» (text behind subject), auto-reframed 16:9 → 9:16
freeze-frame character intro: grey world, colour hero with sticker outline, tag pointing at his face

craft.camera: slow push on a held frame
craft.audioCue: riser into an impact, pop on the tag

shots.purpose: brand pixels orbit his head behind and in front of him; a label rides his head; a jump cut is hidden by a punch-in at 6.8

craft.audioCue: whoosh on unfreeze and on the punch-in

shots.purpose: payoff: the footage shrinks into a card; the cutout is not clipped, so his head breaks out of the frame; title

craft.audioCue: whoosh, impact on the title, chime
